mapper.select: SELECT invoice_id, receivable_id, customer_id, contract_id, status, version, gross_amount FROM oa_invoice WHERE invoice_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT writeoff_id, invoice_id, business_id, business_type, writeoff_amount, writeoff_date FROM oa_invoice_writeoff WHERE writeoff_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
SELECT invoice_id FROM oa_invoice WHERE receivable_id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY invoice_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(writeoff.writeoff_amount), 0) FROM oa_invoice_writeoff writeoff JOIN oa_invoice invoice ON invoice.invoice_id = writeoff.invoice_id AND invoice.tenant_id = writeoff.tenant_id LEFT JOIN crm_deal_event event ON event.tenant_id = writeoff.tenant_id AND event.event_key = CONCAT('OA_INVOICE_RECEIPT:', writeoff.invoice_id, ':', writeoff.writeoff_id) WHERE invoice.receivable_id = #{id} AND writeoff.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND writeoff.business_type = 'CRM_RECEIVABLE' AND writeoff.business_id = #{id} AND event.event_id IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM outbox_event source WHERE source.tenant_id = writeoff.tenant_id AND source.aggregate_type = 'cloudflow-service-oa' AND source.aggregate_id = writeoff.invoice_id AND source.event_type = 'INVOICE_RECEIVABLE_CHANGED' AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(source.payload_json, '$.payload')), '$.writeoffId')) = writeoff.writeoff_id)
